title: Prime Certificates for Exact Vertex-Coprime Ramsey Numbers
summary: Let $G_n$ be the coprime graph on $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. We prove that the mixed vertex-coloring coprime Ramsey number satisfies \[ \Rcop(k_1,\ldots,k_c)=p_{\sum_{i=1}^c(k_i-1)}, \] where $p_m$ is the $m$-th prime. The proof is elementary: the prime clique $\{1\}\cup\{p\le n:p\text{ prime}\}$ gives the upper bound by pigeonhole, while a prime-bin partition gives the matching lower bound by coloring each composite with a bin containing one of its prime divisors.
